subject: resources.os_memory_reserve_percent
what: Percentage of system RAM reserved for the OS and desktop outside agent-work.slice.
why: Keeps the desktop, SSH and system services responsive when coding agents spike memory.
risk: medium: setting the reserve too low can starve system services under heavy agent load.
undo: Reset resources.os_memory_reserve_percent in the profile and re-apply resource-limits.

sources.purpose: systemd cgroup v2 memory and CPU control reference
